Its claim that grain refinement itself increases macroscopic surface-to-volume ratio is flawed and deposition temperature also confounds grain size with chemical order, but B is less decisive and extrapolates evidence from a different FCC, second-order, negligibly hysteretic HEA to a first-order hexagonal transition where defect removal could instead increase the nucleation barrier and hysteresis.
